en: Sura 37: As-Saffat
ja: 第37章 整列者章

p.src: 37:1  By those [angels] lined up in rows,

en: By those [angels] lined up in rows,
ja: 列をなす整列者たち[1]にかけて（、誓う）。[2]
u.src: 37:1  By those [angels] lined up in rows,

ja: [1]　アッラー*に仕えるため、整列する天使*たちのこと、とされる（アッ＝サァディー７００頁参照）。 [2]　これは、アッラー*の近い。アッラー*は、かれがお望みになるもので誓われるが、人間はアッラー*以外のものにおいて誓ってはならない（ムヤッサル４４６頁参照）。

p.src: 37:2  and those who drive [the clouds],

en: and those who drive [the clouds],
ja: また、力強く追い立てる者たち、
u.src: 37:2  and those who drive [the clouds],

p.src: 37:3  and those who recite Allah’s words[1],

en: and those who recite Allah’s words[1],
ja: そして、教訓を読誦する者たちにかけて。[1]
u.src: 37:3  and those who recite Allah’s words[1],

en: [1] Allah swears by three kinds of angels in these three above-mentioned verses to emphasize what comes in the next verse.
ja: [1]　大半の解釈学者は、アーヤ*2を「雲を追いやり、移動させる」天使*たちのことであるとし、このアーヤ*も「アッラー*の教訓を読誦する」天使*たちである、としている（アッ＝シャルビーニー３：４４８参照）。

p.src: 37:4  indeed, your God is One,

en: indeed, your God is One,
ja: （人々よ、）本当にあなた方の崇拝*すべきは、ただお一方、
u.src: 37:4  indeed, your God is One,

p.src: 37:5  Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the points of sunrise.

en: Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the points of sunrise.
ja: 諸天と大地とその間にあるものの主*、いくつもの東[1]の主。
u.src: 37:5  Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the points of sunrise.

ja: [1]　ここでの「東」は、同年において毎日異なる、太陽の昇る地点のこととされる。また、「陽の目を見る、全てのものの主」という説もある（アル＝バガウィー４：2６参照）。

p.src: 37:6  We have adorned the sky with the beauty of the stars,

en: We have adorned the sky with the beauty of the stars,
ja: 本当にわれら*は、最下層の天を、星々という装飾で飾った。
u.src: 37:6  We have adorned the sky with the beauty of the stars,

p.src: 37:7  and for safeguarding it against every rebellious devil,

en: and for safeguarding it against every rebellious devil,
ja: 反抗的な、あらゆるシャイターン*からの護衛のため。
u.src: 37:7  and for safeguarding it against every rebellious devil,

p.src: 37:8  so that they cannot eavesdrop on the highest assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side[2]

en: so that they cannot eavesdrop on the highest assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side[2]
ja: 彼ら（シャイターン*）は、（天の）最上層の貴人たち（である天使*たちが、啓示について話すこと）に聞き耳を立てては、あらゆる方向から（流星で）撃たれ（、それを阻止され）る。
u.src: 37:8  so that they cannot eavesdrop on the highest assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side[2]

en: [2] By meteors.

p.src: 37:9  to repel them; and for them there will be a perpetual punishment,

en: to repel them; and for them there will be a perpetual punishment,
ja: （彼らを）放逐すべく。そして彼らには（来世で）、常なる懲罰がある。
u.src: 37:9  to repel them; and for them there will be a perpetual punishment,

p.src: 37:10  except who stealthily snatches away some words, he will be pursued by a piercing flame.

en: except who stealthily snatches away some words, he will be pursued by a piercing flame.
ja: 但し、（話を）さっと掠め取り、貫く流星によって追尾される者は別である。[1]
u.src: 37:10  except who stealthily snatches away some words, he will be pursued by a piercing flame.

ja: [1]　アル＝ヒジュル章1７－1８、詩人たち章212，22３とその訳注、王権章５、ジン*章８－９も参照。

p.src: 37:11  So ask them, “Are they more difficult to create or other things We created? We created them[3] from sticky clay.

en: So ask them, “Are they more difficult to create or other things We created? We created them[3] from sticky clay.
ja: （使徒*よ、）彼ら（復活を否定する者たち）に聞いてみよ。一体彼らがより強力なのか、それともわれら*が創造した（これらの）ものか？本当にわれら*は、彼ら（の父祖アーダム*）をねばねばする泥土から創ったのだぞ[1]。
u.src: 37:11  So ask them, “Are they more difficult to create or other things We created? We created them[3] from sticky clay.

en: [3] i.e., their father Adam.
ja: [1]　人間の創造の変遷については、巡礼*章５、信仰者たち章1４とその訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:12  Rather you are astonished, while they ridicule it,

en: Rather you are astonished, while they ridicule it,
ja: いや（使徒*よ）、あなたは（彼らが復活を否定することに）驚いた。彼らは（あなたの言葉を）嘲笑している。
u.src: 37:12  Rather you are astonished, while they ridicule it,

p.src: 37:13  and when they are reminded, they pay no heed,

en: and when they are reminded, they pay no heed,
ja: また喚起させられても、教訓を得ない。
u.src: 37:13  and when they are reminded, they pay no heed,

p.src: 37:14  and when they see a sign, they ridicule it,

en: and when they see a sign, they ridicule it,
ja: そして（あなたの預言者*性を示す）御徴を見れば、嘲笑する。
u.src: 37:14  and when they see a sign, they ridicule it,

p.src: 37:15  and they say, “This is nothing but clear magic.

en: and they say, “This is nothing but clear magic.
ja: また、彼らは言った。「これは紛れもない魔術に外ならない。
u.src: 37:15  and they say, “This is nothing but clear magic.

p.src: 37:16  Is it that when we are dead and become dust and bones, will we really be raised up again,

en: Is it that when we are dead and become dust and bones, will we really be raised up again,
ja: 一体、死んで土と骨と化した後で、本当に私たちが蘇らされる身であるなどというのか？
u.src: 37:16  Is it that when we are dead and become dust and bones, will we really be raised up again,

p.src: 37:17  and our forefathers too?”

en: and our forefathers too?”
ja: そして、私たちの昔のご先祖様たちも？」
u.src: 37:17  and our forefathers too?”

p.src: 37:18  Say, “Yes, and you will be disgraced.”

en: Say, “Yes, and you will be disgraced.”
ja: （使徒*よ、）言ってやれ。「ああ。あなた方は蔑まれた者となって（、蘇らされる）」。
u.src: 37:18  Say, “Yes, and you will be disgraced.”

p.src: 37:19  It will only be a single Blast[4], and at once they will be looking around.

en: It will only be a single Blast[4], and at once they will be looking around.
ja: それは、ただの一声[1]に過ぎないのだぞ。するとどうであろうか、彼らは（蘇って、復活の日*の恐怖を）目の当たりにする。
u.src: 37:19  It will only be a single Blast[4], and at once they will be looking around.

en: [4] i.e., the second blow of the Trumpet.
ja: [1]　この「一声」は、二回目の角笛とされる（アル＝クルトゥビー1５：７2参照）。家畜章７３の訳注も参照。

p.src: 37:20  They will say, “Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!”

en: They will say, “Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!”
ja: そして彼らは言う。「我らが災いよ！[1]これは報いの日*だ」。
u.src: 37:20  They will say, “Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!”

ja: [1]　「我らが災いよ」という表現については、食卓章３1の訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:21  [They will be told], “This is the Day of Decision that you used to deny.”

en: [They will be told], “This is the Day of Decision that you used to deny.”
ja: （すると、彼らに言われる。）「これが、あなた方が（現世で）嘘呼ばわりしていた裁決の日[1]である」。[2]
u.src: 37:21  [They will be told], “This is the Day of Decision that you used to deny.”

ja: [1]　善い行いの者と悪い行いの者が分けられる、「裁決の日」のこと（アル＝バガウィー４：2９参照）。 [2]　この言葉の主には、「アッラー*」「天使*」「地獄の民どうしの言葉」という説がある（アル＝クルトゥビー1５：７2参照）。

p.src: 37:22  [The angels will be told], “Gather all those who did wrong and their fellows[5], and whatever they used to worship

en: [The angels will be told], “Gather all those who did wrong and their fellows[5], and whatever they used to worship
ja: （そして天使*たちに、こう言われる。）不正*を犯した者たちと彼らと同様の者たち[1]、そして彼らが崇めていた者たちを召集せよ。
u.src: 37:22  [The angels will be told], “Gather all those who did wrong and their fellows[5], and whatever they used to worship

en: [5] In wrongdoing or evil deeds.
ja: [1]　「不正*を犯した者たち」とは、シルク*を犯した者たちのこと。それと「同様の者たち」には、「不信仰において同調していた彼らの妻たち」「彼らの仲間であるシャイターン*」といった解釈がある（前掲書1５：７３参照）。

p.src: 37:23  besides Allah, and lead them to the way of Hell,

en: besides Allah, and lead them to the way of Hell,
ja: アッラー*をよそに（崇めていた者たちを）。そして彼らを、火獄の道へと案内せよ。
u.src: 37:23  besides Allah, and lead them to the way of Hell,

p.src: 37:24  and stop them, for they are to be questioned.”

en: and stop them, for they are to be questioned.”
ja: また（地獄に入る前に）、彼らを止めよ。実に彼らは（現世での言動について）、問われる者たちなのだから。[1]
u.src: 37:24  and stop them, for they are to be questioned.”

ja: [1]　食卓章1０９、高壁章８の訳注も参照。

p.src: 37:25  [They will be asked], “What is the matter with you, that you no longer help one another?”

en: [They will be asked], “What is the matter with you, that you no longer help one another?”
ja: （そして彼らには、こう言われる。）「あなた方が互いに助け合わないのは、どういうことか？」
u.src: 37:25  [They will be asked], “What is the matter with you, that you no longer help one another?”

p.src: 37:26  Rather on that Day they will surrender completely.

en: Rather on that Day they will surrender completely.
ja: いや、彼らはその日、（アッラー*のご命令に）降参した者たちなのだ。
u.src: 37:26  Rather on that Day they will surrender completely.

p.src: 37:27  They will turn to one another, reproaching one another.

en: They will turn to one another, reproaching one another.
ja: 彼ら（不信仰者*）は互いに近づき、質問し合う。
u.src: 37:27  They will turn to one another, reproaching one another.

p.src: 37:28  [The followers] will say, “It was you who used to delude us from the right way[6].”

en: [The followers] will say, “It was you who used to delude us from the right way[6].”
ja: 彼ら（他人に倣って不信仰者*となった者たち）は、（自分たちを不信仰へと主導した者たちに）言う。「本当にあなた方は（私たちを迷わせるべく）、右側から私たちのもとにやって来ていた[1]」。[2]
u.src: 37:28  [The followers] will say, “It was you who used to delude us from the right way[6].”

en: [6] Or you used to pressure us, or deceived us with false oaths, or claimed to have the truth.
ja: [1]　「右側から来る」の解釈には、「期待させるようなことを言いつつ」「誓いの言葉を添えつつ」「宗教的側面から」「力づくで」などの諸説がある（アル＝クルトゥビー1５：７５参照）。 [2]　同様の情景の描写として、雌牛章1６６－1６７、高壁章３８、イブラーヒーム*章21－22、識別章1７－1９、物語章６３、部族連合章６７－６８、サバア章３1－３３なども参照。

p.src: 37:29  [The misleaders] will say, “Rather, you yourselves were not believers,

en: [The misleaders] will say, “Rather, you yourselves were not believers,
ja: 彼ら（不信仰へと主導した者たち）は、言う。「いや、あなた方は（そもそも）信仰者（となるべき者）ではなかったのだ。
u.src: 37:29  [The misleaders] will say, “Rather, you yourselves were not believers,

p.src: 37:30  and We had no power over you, rather you yourselves were a transgressing people.

en: and We had no power over you, rather you yourselves were a transgressing people.
ja: また。私たちには（あなた方を信仰から阻むことにおいて）、あなた方に対するいかなる（正当な）根拠[1]もなかった。いや、あなた方は放埓な民だったのである。
u.src: 37:30  and We had no power over you, rather you yourselves were a transgressing people.

ja: [1]　イブラーヒーム*章22の同語に関する訳注も参照。

p.src: 37:31  Now the punishment of our Lord has come true against us; we will surely taste it.

en: Now the punishment of our Lord has come true against us; we will surely taste it.
ja: それで私たちに対して、我らが主*の御言葉[1]が実現したのだ。本当に私たちは、まさしく（懲罰を）味わう者たちなのである。
u.src: 37:31  Now the punishment of our Lord has come true against us; we will surely taste it.

ja: [1]　この「御言葉」は、アッ＝サジダ*章1３にある、懲罰の言葉とされる（アル＝バガウィー４：３０参照）。

p.src: 37:32  We did misguide you, for we ourselves were misguided”.

en: We did misguide you, for we ourselves were misguided”.
ja: そして私たちは、あなた方を（正しい道から）逸脱させた。本当に私たちは、誤った者たちであった」。
u.src: 37:32  We did misguide you, for we ourselves were misguided”.

p.src: 37:33  On that Day they will all share in the punishment.

en: On that Day they will all share in the punishment.
ja: （復活*の）その日、本当に彼らは（全員）、共に懲罰の中にある。
u.src: 37:33  On that Day they will all share in the punishment.

p.src: 37:34  This is how We deal with the wicked,

en: This is how We deal with the wicked,
ja: 本当にわれら*は罪悪者たちに対し、このようにするのだ。
u.src: 37:34  This is how We deal with the wicked,

p.src: 37:35  for whenever it was said to them, “None has the right to be worshiped except Allah,” they became arrogant,

en: for whenever it was said to them, “None has the right to be worshiped except Allah,” they became arrogant,
ja: 実に彼らは、「アッラー*の外に、崇拝*すべきいかなるものもない（、と言いなさい）」と言われた時、（そうせずに）奢り高ぶっていた。
u.src: 37:35  for whenever it was said to them, “None has the right to be worshiped except Allah,” they became arrogant,

p.src: 37:36  and said, “Are we going to abandon our gods for a mad poet[7]?”

en: and said, “Are we going to abandon our gods for a mad poet[7]?”
ja: そして、彼らは言うのだ。「一体、本当に私たちが、憑かれた[1]詩人（ムハンマド*のこと）ゆえに、自分たちの神々[2]を棄て去ろうか？」
u.src: 37:36  and said, “Are we going to abandon our gods for a mad poet[7]?”

en: [7] They mean the Prophet (ﷺ).
ja: [1]　アル＝ヒジュル章６「憑かれた者」の訳注も参照。 [2]　「神々」に関しては、雌牛章1３３の訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:37  Rather, he came with the truth and confirmed the messengers.

en: Rather, he came with the truth and confirmed the messengers.
ja: いや、彼（ムハンマド*）は真実を携えてやって来たのであり、（彼以前に）遣わされた（預言）者*たち（がアッラー*について伝えたこと）を確証したのだ。
u.src: 37:37  Rather, he came with the truth and confirmed the messengers.

p.src: 37:38  You will surely taste the painful punishment,

en: You will surely taste the painful punishment,
ja: 本当に（シルク*の徒よ、）あなた方はまさに、痛ましい懲罰を味わう者たちである。
u.src: 37:38  You will surely taste the painful punishment,

p.src: 37:39  and you will only be recompensed for what you used to do,

en: and you will only be recompensed for what you used to do,
ja: そしてあなた方が（来世で）報われるのは、自分たちが（現世で）行っていたこと（によるもの）以外の、何ものでもない。
u.src: 37:39  and you will only be recompensed for what you used to do,

p.src: 37:40  except the chosen slaves of Allah.

en: except the chosen slaves of Allah.
ja: 但し、精選されたアッラー*の僕たち[1]は別であるが。
u.src: 37:40  except the chosen slaves of Allah.

ja: [1]　「精選されたアッラー*の僕」については、ユースフ*章2４の訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:41  They will have a known provision,

en: They will have a known provision,
ja: それらの者たちには、周知の糧[1]がある。
u.src: 37:41  They will have a known provision,

ja: [1]　その永遠性、美味さといった特質において、「周知の」糧（アル＝バイダーウィー５：11参照）。

p.src: 37:42  fruits[8]; and they will be honored

en: fruits[8]; and they will be honored
ja: （それは）果実であり、彼らは厚遇される者たち。
u.src: 37:42  fruits[8]; and they will be honored

en: [8] i.e., everything delicious that they desire.

p.src: 37:43  in Gardens of Bliss,

en: in Gardens of Bliss,
ja: 安寧の楽園で、
u.src: 37:43  in Gardens of Bliss,

p.src: 37:44  facing one another[9] on couches.

en: facing one another[9] on couches.
ja: 互いに向かい合いつつ[1]、寝台の上に。
u.src: 37:44  facing one another[9] on couches.

en: [9] It implies that they will not harbor ill feelings toward one another.
ja: [1]　アル＝ヒジュル章４７の訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:45  They will be served with a cup of wine from a flowing stream,

en: They will be served with a cup of wine from a flowing stream,
ja: （酒の）湧き水からの盃が、彼らに回される。
u.src: 37:45  They will be served with a cup of wine from a flowing stream,

p.src: 37:46  white and delicious for those who drink.

en: white and delicious for those who drink.
ja: （その盃は）白く、飲む者たちにとって美味なもの。
u.src: 37:46  white and delicious for those who drink.

p.src: 37:47  It will cause no harm, nor will they be intoxicated by it,

en: It will cause no harm, nor will they be intoxicated by it,
ja: そこには（頭や腹の）痛みもなければ、それゆえに理性を失うこともない。
u.src: 37:47  It will cause no harm, nor will they be intoxicated by it,

p.src: 37:48  and with them will be maidens of modest gaze[10] and beautiful eyes,

en: and with them will be maidens of modest gaze[10] and beautiful eyes,
ja: また彼らのもとには、（自分の夫だけに）視線を定めた[1]、麗しい眼の女性たちがいる。
u.src: 37:48  and with them will be maidens of modest gaze[10] and beautiful eyes,

en: [10] i.e., chaste and bashful, looking only at their mates.
ja: [1]　天国の妻は貞淑で、夫以外の誰のそばにも近づかない。そしてそれは彼女の夫もまた美しく、完全であるためである。あるいは、彼女が夫だけを見つめるのは、夫が完全な美しさを備えた彼女だけを見つめているからなのである（アッ＝サァディー７０2頁参照）。雌牛章2５「純潔な妻」、及び煙霧章５４の訳注も参照。

p.src: 37:49  as if they were well-protected eggs[11].

en: as if they were well-protected eggs[11].
ja: 彼女たちはまるで、秘められた卵[1]のよう。
u.src: 37:49  as if they were well-protected eggs[11].

en: [11] Or pristine pearls.
ja: [1]　「秘められた卵」の意味には、「その羽で風や埃（ほこり）から守った、ダチョウの卵。黄色地に白身がかった色で、最も美しい女性の色の象徴」「殻（から）が割れる前の、卵の中身のこと」「卵の薄い殻」「真珠のたとえ」といった諸説がある（アル＝クルトゥビー1５：８０－８1参照）。

p.src: 37:50  Then they will turn to one another asking[12].

en: Then they will turn to one another asking[12].
ja: 彼らは互いに近づき、（現世における彼らの状態について、）質問し合う。
u.src: 37:50  Then they will turn to one another asking[12].

en: [12] Of their lives in the world and what led them to Paradise.

p.src: 37:51  One of them will say, “I had a close friend [in the world]

en: One of them will say, “I had a close friend [in the world]
ja: 彼ら（天国の民）の内の、ある者は言う。「本当に私には（現世で）、付きまとう者[1]がありました。
u.src: 37:51  One of them will say, “I had a close friend [in the world]

ja: [1]　これには「シャイターン*」「人間」「兄弟」などの説があるが、いずれにせよ復活を否定する者であった（アル＝バガウィー４：３2参照）。

p.src: 37:52  who used to say[13], ‘Are you one of those who believe

en: who used to say[13], ‘Are you one of those who believe
ja: 彼は（こう）言っていました。『本当にあなたは、（復活を）信じるというのか？
u.src: 37:52  who used to say[13], ‘Are you one of those who believe

en: [13] Mockingly.

p.src: 37:53  that when we die and become dust and bones, shall we be brought for judgment?’”

en: that when we die and become dust and bones, shall we be brought for judgment?’”
ja: 死んで土と骨と化した後で、本当に私たちが（蘇らされ、自分の行いで）報われる身であると？』」
u.src: 37:53  that when we die and become dust and bones, shall we be brought for judgment?’”

p.src: 37:54  He will say[14], “Do you wish to see [his fate]?”

en: He will say[14], “Do you wish to see [his fate]?”
ja: 彼（天国の民のある者）は、（仲間たちに）言う。「あなた方は、（現世で付きまとっていたその者の結末を）見てみますか？」
u.src: 37:54  He will say[14], “Do you wish to see [his fate]?”

en: [14] To his companions in Paradise.

p.src: 37:55  So he will look down and see him[15] in the midst of the Blazing Fire.

en: So he will look down and see him[15] in the midst of the Blazing Fire.
ja: それで見てみると、かれが火獄の真ん中にいるのを目にする。
u.src: 37:55  So he will look down and see him[15] in the midst of the Blazing Fire.

en: [15] His close friend who tried to dissuade him from faith.

p.src: 37:56  He will say, “By Allah, you were about to ruin me.

en: He will say, “By Allah, you were about to ruin me.
ja: 彼は（現世で付きまとっていた者に、）言う。「アッラー*に誓って。本当にあなたは、私のことを（信仰の妨害によって、）まさしく（破滅へと）転落させるところだった。
u.src: 37:56  He will say, “By Allah, you were about to ruin me.

p.src: 37:57  Were it not for the grace of my Lord, I would have been among those who are brought [to Hell].”

en: Were it not for the grace of my Lord, I would have been among those who are brought [to Hell].”
ja: そしてもし、（信仰という）我が主*の恩恵がなければ、私は（あなたと共に懲罰へと）連行される者となっていた。
u.src: 37:57  Were it not for the grace of my Lord, I would have been among those who are brought [to Hell].”

p.src: 37:58  [He will say to his fellow believers], “Are we not going to die anymore,

en: [He will say to his fellow believers], “Are we not going to die anymore,
ja: 私たちは（永遠に安寧を味わう者であり、）死にゆく者ではないのではないか？
u.src: 37:58  [He will say to his fellow believers], “Are we not going to die anymore,

p.src: 37:59  except for our first death, nor are we going to be punished?”

en: except for our first death, nor are we going to be punished?”
ja: ただ、（現世で）一度の死だけ（を味わったのみ）であり、（天国に入った後、）私たちは罰されることなどないのではないか？
u.src: 37:59  except for our first death, nor are we going to be punished?”

p.src: 37:60  This is indeed the supreme triumph!

en: This is indeed the supreme triumph!
ja: 本当にこれこそは、まさに偉大なる勝利。
u.src: 37:60  This is indeed the supreme triumph!

p.src: 37:61  For such [reward] let the workers work.

en: For such [reward] let the workers work.
ja: このようなもの（の獲得）のためにこそ、勤行者たちは、（現世で）勤行するがよい」。[1]
u.src: 37:61  For such [reward] let the workers work.

ja: [1]　アーヤ*６０－６1は、天国の民の言葉ではなく、アッラー*の御言葉という説もある（アル＝バイダーウィー５：1４参照）。

p.src: 37:62  Is this a better accommodation or the tree of Zaqqūm[16]?[17]

en: Is this a better accommodation or the tree of Zaqqūm[16]?[17]
ja: 一体それが、より善い御もてなしなのか、それともザックームの木[1]か？
u.src: 37:62  Is this a better accommodation or the tree of Zaqqūm[16]?[17]

en:
[16] The tree of cactus.
 [17] The disbelievers of Makkah derided the Prophet (ﷺ) when he warned them of this tree. They wondered how a tree could grow in Hellfire. So Allah revealed this verse.
ja: [1]　夜の旅章６０「呪われた木」の訳注、および煙霧章４３－４６、出来事章５2－５３を参照。

p.src: 37:63  We have made it a trial for the wrongdoers.

en: We have made it a trial for the wrongdoers.
ja: 本当にわれらはそれを、不正*者たちの試練としたのだ。
u.src: 37:63  We have made it a trial for the wrongdoers.

p.src: 37:64  It is a tree that grows in the bottom of the Blazing Fire;

en: It is a tree that grows in the bottom of the Blazing Fire;
ja: 実にそれは、火獄の奥底に生え出る木。
u.src: 37:64  It is a tree that grows in the bottom of the Blazing Fire;

p.src: 37:65  its fruits are like heads of devils.

en: its fruits are like heads of devils.
ja: その実は、あたかもシャイターン*の頭のよう（に醜い）。
u.src: 37:65  its fruits are like heads of devils.

p.src: 37:66  They will certainly eat from it, filling their bellies.

en: They will certainly eat from it, filling their bellies.
ja: 本当に彼ら（シルク*の徒）は、まさしくそこから食べ、それで腹を満たすことになる。
u.src: 37:66  They will certainly eat from it, filling their bellies.

p.src: 37:67  Then on top of that they will be given a mixture of scalding water,

en: Then on top of that they will be given a mixture of scalding water,
ja: それから本当に彼らには、その上に煮えたぎる湯の混じった（飲み）物がある。
u.src: 37:67  Then on top of that they will be given a mixture of scalding water,

p.src: 37:68  then their final return will be to the Blazing Fire.

en: then their final return will be to the Blazing Fire.
ja: それから彼らの戻り場所こそは、まさに火獄なのだ。
u.src: 37:68  then their final return will be to the Blazing Fire.

p.src: 37:69  For they found their forefathers astray,

en: For they found their forefathers astray,
ja: 本当に彼らは、自分たちの先祖が（シルク*を犯して）迷っているのを認め、
u.src: 37:69  For they found their forefathers astray,

p.src: 37:70  so they rushed to follow in their footsteps.

en: so they rushed to follow in their footsteps.
ja: その跡を辿って急ぐのだから（、そのような結末となったのである）。
u.src: 37:70  so they rushed to follow in their footsteps.

p.src: 37:71  Indeed, most of the earlier people went astray before them,

en: Indeed, most of the earlier people went astray before them,
ja: 彼ら以前にも確かに、昔の人々の多くが（真理から）迷った。
u.src: 37:71  Indeed, most of the earlier people went astray before them,

p.src: 37:72  even though We sent among them warners.

en: even though We sent among them warners.
ja: そしてわれら*は確かに、彼らに警告者たちを遣わしたのである。
u.src: 37:72  even though We sent among them warners.

p.src: 37:73  Then see how was the end of those who were warned,

en: Then see how was the end of those who were warned,
ja: ならば、見てみるがよい。警告された者たちの結末がいかなるものであったかを？
u.src: 37:73  Then see how was the end of those who were warned,

p.src: 37:74  except the chosen slaves of Allah.

en: except the chosen slaves of Allah.
ja: 但し、精選されたアッラー*の僕たち[1]は別であるが。
u.src: 37:74  except the chosen slaves of Allah.

ja: [1]　「精選されたアッラー*の僕」については、ユースフ*章2４の訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:75  Indeed, Noah called upon Us; how excellent are We at responding!

en: Indeed, Noah called upon Us; how excellent are We at responding!
ja: ヌーフ*は確かに、われら*に呼びかけた[1]。（彼に）応えられるお方の、何とまさしく素晴らしいことか。
u.src: 37:75  Indeed, Noah called upon Us; how excellent are We at responding!

ja: [1]　呼びかけた祈願の内容については、月章1０、ヌーフ*章2６－2７を参照。また、ヌーフ*とその民の間の出来事については、高壁章５９－６４、フード*章2５－４８、信仰者たち章2３－３０、詩人たち章1０５－122、月章９－1７なども参照。

p.src: 37:76  And We saved him and his household[18] from the great distress,

en: And We saved him and his household[18] from the great distress,
ja: そしてわれら*は、彼とその家族をこの上ない苦悩[1]から救った。
u.src: 37:76  And We saved him and his household[18] from the great distress,

en: [18] i.e., the believers in his household.
ja: [1]　「この上ない苦悩」については、預言者*たち章７６の訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:77  and made his offspring[19] the only survivors,

en: and made his offspring[19] the only survivors,
ja: また、われら*はその子孫を（溺れずに）生き残る者とした。
u.src: 37:77  and made his offspring[19] the only survivors,

en: [19] i.e., Noah’s offspring: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

p.src: 37:78  and We left for him [a favorable mention] among later generations:

en: and We left for him [a favorable mention] among later generations:
ja: そして後世の人々の内に、彼へ（の賛美を）残しておいた。[1]
u.src: 37:78  and We left for him [a favorable mention] among later generations:

ja: [1]　アッラー*は復活の日*まで、彼が他の預言者*たちや民の間で、賛美され、褒（ほ）めたたえるようにされた（アル＝バガウィー４：３４参照）。

p.src: 37:79  “Peace be upon Noah among all the nations.”

en: “Peace be upon Noah among all the nations.”
ja: 全創造物において、ヌーフ*に平安を。[1]
u.src: 37:79  “Peace be upon Noah among all the nations.”

ja: [1]　一説に、この「平安」はアッラー*からの御言葉で、誰からも彼が悪く言われることはない、というアッラー*からの保証のこと。また一説に、これは彼が復活の日*まで、「平安を」という挨拶（家畜章５４の訳注を参照）を受け続けるということ（イブン・アティーヤ４：４７８参照）。

p.src: 37:80  This is how We reward those who do good.

en: This is how We reward those who do good.
ja: 本当にわれら*はこのように、善を尽くす者[1]たちに報いるのだ。
u.src: 37:80  This is how We reward those who do good.

ja: [1]　「善を尽くす者」については、蜜蜂章12８の訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:81  He was one of Our believing slaves.

en: He was one of Our believing slaves.
ja: 実に彼（ヌーフ*）は、信仰者であるわれら*の僕たちの一人である。
u.src: 37:81  He was one of Our believing slaves.

p.src: 37:82  Then we drowned the others.

en: Then we drowned the others.
ja: それからわれら*は、（信仰者ではない）他の者たちを溺れさせた。
u.src: 37:82  Then we drowned the others.

p.src: 37:83  Indeed, Abraham was one of those who followed his way.

en: Indeed, Abraham was one of those who followed his way.
ja: また、彼（ヌーフ*）の党派[1]の一人が、まさしくイブラーヒーム*である。
u.src: 37:83  Indeed, Abraham was one of those who followed his way.

ja: [1]　その宗教と手法において、同じ党派であったということ（ムヤッサル４４９頁参照）。

p.src: 37:84  When he came to his Lord with a sound heart,

en: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart,
ja: 彼が健全な心[1]と共に、その主*の御許へやって来た時[2]のこと。
u.src: 37:84  When he came to his Lord with a sound heart,

ja: [1]　「健全な心」については、詩人たち章８９の訳注を参照。 [2]　「主*の御許へやって来た時」とは、アッラーの唯一性*とかれへの服従へと人々を招いた時のこと、あるいは、彼が日の中に放り込まれた時のことを指す、とされる（アル＝クルトゥビー1５：９1参照）。イブラーヒーム*とその父親、及びその民のやり取りについては、家畜章７４－８2、マルヤム*章４2－４８、預言者*たち章５2－７０、詩人たち章７０－８９、金の装飾章2６－2８も参照。

p.src: 37:85  and said to his father and his people, “What are you worshiping?

en: and said to his father and his people, “What are you worshiping?
ja: 彼がその父と民に、（こう）言った時。「あなた方は、何を崇めているのですか？」
u.src: 37:85  and said to his father and his people, “What are you worshiping?

p.src: 37:86  Is it false gods that you seek other than Allah?

en: Is it false gods that you seek other than Allah?
ja: でっち上げ、つまりアッラー*以外の神々[1]を、あなた方は求めているのですか？
u.src: 37:86  Is it false gods that you seek other than Allah?

ja: [1]　「神々」に関しては、雌牛章1３３の訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:87  Then what do you think of the Lord of the worlds?”

en: Then what do you think of the Lord of the worlds?”
ja: 全創造物の主*についての、あなた方のご推測はいかがなものなのですか？[1]」
u.src: 37:87  Then what do you think of the Lord of the worlds?”

ja: [1]　もしあなた方がアッラー*にシルク*を犯したら、かれはあなた方をどうされると思うのか、ということ（ムヤッサル４４９頁参照）。

p.src: 37:88  He then cast a glance at the stars[20],

en: He then cast a glance at the stars[20],
ja: そして彼（イブラーヒーム*）は、星々の方へと視線をやると、[1]
u.src: 37:88  He then cast a glance at the stars[20],

en: [20] His people had faith in astrology, so Abraham pretended to do the same to show them that he was not able to join them at their pagan feast and to remain in their temple of idols, while he was planning to destroy their idols.
ja: [1]　人々と共に祭日に出かけなくても済むよう、言い訳を思案した様子を表す（前掲書、同頁参照）。そしてそれは彼らの不在中に、彫像を破壊するためであった（イブン・カスィール７：2４参照）。この一連の出来事については、預言者*たち章５７－７０とその訳注も参照。

p.src: 37:89  and said, “I am sick[21].”

en: and said, “I am sick[21].”
ja: （民に）言った。「本当に私は、病気なのです」。
u.src: 37:89  and said, “I am sick[21].”

en: [21] The Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Ibrahim (peace be upon him) did not lie except for three lies: His saying {I am sick} and his saying {Rather, the chief of them did this} and his saying about his wife, “She is my sister.” [Al-Bukhāri, Muslim]. Two of them were for the sake of Allah, and the third one was for the sake of his sister.

p.src: 37:90  So they went away from him and left.

en: So they went away from him and left.
ja: こうして彼らは背を向けて、（イブラーヒーム*を後に）立ち去った。
u.src: 37:90  So they went away from him and left.

p.src: 37:91  Then he turned to their gods and said, “Why do you not eat[22]?

en: Then he turned to their gods and said, “Why do you not eat[22]?
ja: それから彼（イブラーヒーム*）は、彼らの神々（彫像）のところへ赴き、（蔑んで）言った。「あなた方は、（供え物の食事を）食べないのか？
u.src: 37:91  Then he turned to their gods and said, “Why do you not eat[22]?

en: [22] The offerings placed before you.

p.src: 37:92  What is wrong with you that you do not speak?”

en: What is wrong with you that you do not speak?”
ja: あなた方が喋らないのは、どういうことか？」
u.src: 37:92  What is wrong with you that you do not speak?”

p.src: 37:93  Then he turned upon them, striking them with his right hand.

en: Then he turned upon them, striking them with his right hand.
ja: そして彼は右の手で殴り（壊し）つつ、それらを回った。
u.src: 37:93  Then he turned upon them, striking them with his right hand.

p.src: 37:94  Then his people came rushing towards him.

en: Then his people came rushing towards him.
ja: こうして彼ら（民）は、彼（イブラーヒーム*）のもとに、駆け足でやって来た。
u.src: 37:94  Then his people came rushing towards him.

p.src: 37:95  He said, “Do you worship what you yourselves carve,

en: He said, “Do you worship what you yourselves carve,
ja: 彼（イブラーヒーム*）は言った。「一体あなた方は、自分たちが彫ったものを崇めるのですか？
u.src: 37:95  He said, “Do you worship what you yourselves carve,

p.src: 37:96  when it is Allah Who created you and all what you do?”

en: when it is Allah Who created you and all what you do?”
ja: アッラー*があなた方と、あなた方が行うもの[1]をお創りになったというのに？」
u.src: 37:96  when it is Allah Who created you and all what you do?”

ja: [1]　「あなた方が行うもの」とは、「行為一般」または「作成した彫像のこと」（イブン・カスィール７：2４頁参照）。

p.src: 37:97  They said, “Build a pyre for him and throw him into the blazing fire.”

en: They said, “Build a pyre for him and throw him into the blazing fire.”
ja: 彼らは言った。「彼のために建屋を建て（て、そこに火をつけ）、彼を火獄の中へと放り込んでしまえ」。[1]
u.src: 37:97  They said, “Build a pyre for him and throw him into the blazing fire.”

ja: [1]　預言者*たち章６９－７０とその訳注も参照。

p.src: 37:98  They contrived a plan against him, but We made them the lowest.

en: They contrived a plan against him, but We made them the lowest.
ja: こうして彼らは彼（イブラーヒーム*）に策略を望んだが、われら*は彼らを敗北者とした。
u.src: 37:98  They contrived a plan against him, but We made them the lowest.

p.src: 37:99  He said, “I am going to my Lord; He will guide me.

en: He said, “I am going to my Lord; He will guide me.
ja: また、彼は言った。「私はまさしく、我が主*の御許へと赴く[1]者である。かれは私を、お導き下さろう。
u.src: 37:99  He said, “I am going to my Lord; He will guide me.

ja: [1]　不信仰の民*の土地から、アッラー*の崇拝*が出来る土地へと移住すること（ムヤッサル４４９頁参照）。預言者*たち章７1とその訳注も参照。

p.src: 37:100  My Lord, grant me righteous offspring.”

en: My Lord, grant me righteous offspring.”
ja: 我が主*よ、私に正しい者*たちから（の者となる子供を）、お授け下さい」。
u.src: 37:100  My Lord, grant me righteous offspring.”

p.src: 37:101  So We gave him glad tidings of a forbearing boy[23].

en: So We gave him glad tidings of a forbearing boy[23].
ja: それでわれら*は、彼に、寛大な（者となる）男児（イスマーイール*）の吉報を伝えた。
u.src: 37:101  So We gave him glad tidings of a forbearing boy[23].

en: [23] i.e., Ishmael

p.src: 37:102  Then when he reached the age where he could work with him, Abraham said, “O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice you. What do you think?” He said, “O my dear father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, one of the steadfast.”

en: Then when he reached the age where he could work with him, Abraham said, “O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice you. What do you think?” He said, “O my dear father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, one of the steadfast.”
ja: こうして、彼（イスマーイール*）が彼（イブラーヒーム*）と共に働くようになるまで成長した時、彼（イブラーヒーム*）は言った。「息子よ、実に私は夢で、私がお前のことを屠るのを見る[1]のだ。ならば、お前はどう思うか、考えてみるがよい」。彼（イスマーイール*）は言った。「お父さん、あなたが命じられることをして下さい。あなたはーーアッラー*がお望みならーー、私が忍耐*強い者であることを見出すでしょう」。
u.src: 37:102  Then when he reached the age where he could work with him, Abraham said, “O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice you. What do you think?” He said, “O my dear father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, one of the steadfast.”

ja: [1]　つまり、アッラー*が夢の中で彼を屠（ほふ）るようにご命じになる、ということ。預言者*の夢は啓示である、と言われる（アッ＝サァディー７０５頁参照）。

p.src: 37:103  When they both submitted [to Allah’s command] and Abraham laid him on his forehead,

en: When they both submitted [to Allah’s command] and Abraham laid him on his forehead,
ja: こうして彼らが（主*のご命令に）服し、彼（イブラーヒーム*）が彼（イスマーイール*）を、こめかみを（地面に）つけて（横向きに）倒した時、
u.src: 37:103  When they both submitted [to Allah’s command] and Abraham laid him on his forehead,

p.src: 37:104  and We called out to him, “O Abraham,

en: and We called out to him, “O Abraham,
ja: われら*は彼に呼びかけた。「イブラーヒーム*よ、
u.src: 37:104  and We called out to him, “O Abraham,

p.src: 37:105  You have fulfilled the dream.” This is how We reward those who do good.

en: You have fulfilled the dream.” This is how We reward those who do good.
ja: あなたは確かに夢を確証した。実にわれら*は善を尽くす者[1]たちに対し、このように報いるのだ。
u.src: 37:105  You have fulfilled the dream.” This is how We reward those who do good.

ja: [1]　「善を尽くす者」については、蜜蜂章12８の訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:106  This was indeed a revealing test.

en: This was indeed a revealing test.
ja: 本当にこれこそはまさしく、紛れもなき試練であった」。
u.src: 37:106  This was indeed a revealing test.

p.src: 37:107  And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice[24],

en: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice[24],
ja: そしてわれら*は彼（イスマーイール*）を、この上ない犠牲で償った。[1]
u.src: 37:107  And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice[24],

en: [24] Allah Almighty sent a ram to be sacrificed in place of Ishmael.
ja: [1]　「この上ない犠牲」とは大きな羊のこと。これがイスマーイール*の代わりに屠られた（ムヤッサル４５０頁参照）。

p.src: 37:108  and We left for him [a favorable mention] among later generations:

u.src: 37:111  He was one of Our believing slaves.

p.src: 37:112  And We gave him the glad tidings of Isaac[25], a prophet, and one of the righteous.

en: And We gave him the glad tidings of Isaac[25], a prophet, and one of the righteous.
ja: またわれら*は彼（イブラーヒーム*）に、（後に）正しい者*の一人である預言者*となる、イスハーク*（誕生）の吉報を伝えた。
u.src: 37:112  And We gave him the glad tidings of Isaac[25], a prophet, and one of the righteous.

en: [25] The birth of Isaac is mentioned after the story of sacrifice, which verifies that the firstborn son who was sacrificed was indeed Ishmael and not Isaac, contrary to what is claimed by the Jews and Christians. This is also supported by 11:71, where Sarah is told that she would give birth to Isaac, who would have a son by the name of Jacob.

p.src: 37:113  We blessed him[26] and Isaac, but among their offspring were some who did good and some who clearly wronged themselves.

en: We blessed him[26] and Isaac, but among their offspring were some who did good and some who clearly wronged themselves.
ja: そしてわれら*は、彼（イブラーヒーム*）とイスハーク*を祝福した。彼ら二人の子孫には、善を尽くす者[1]もいれば、自らに明らかな不正*を働く者もいる。
u.src: 37:113  We blessed him[26] and Isaac, but among their offspring were some who did good and some who clearly wronged themselves.

en: [26] Abraham or Ishmael.
ja: [1]　アーヤ*11０の訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:114  Indeed, We bestowed Our favor upon Moses and Aaron,

en: Indeed, We bestowed Our favor upon Moses and Aaron,
ja: またわれら*は確かに、ムーサー*とハールーン*に（預言者*としての使命という）恵を授けた。
u.src: 37:114  Indeed, We bestowed Our favor upon Moses and Aaron,

p.src: 37:115  and We saved them and their people from the great distress[27],

en: and We saved them and their people from the great distress[27],
ja: そして彼ら二人とその民（イスラーイールの子ら*）を、この上ない苦悩[1]から救った。
u.src: 37:115  and We saved them and their people from the great distress[27],

en: [27] Of enslavement at the hands of Pharaoh and his people, as well as of drowning.
ja: [1]　彼らの「苦悩」とは、溺死（できし）のこと（ユーヌス*章９０－９2、ター・ハー章７７－７８、詩人たち章６1－６６、煙霧章2４参照）、またはフィルアウン*に対する隷属（れいぞく）状態と抑圧（雌牛章４９とその訳注を参照）のこと。

p.src: 37:116  and We helped them, so they were victorious,

en: and We helped them, so they were victorious,
ja: またわれら*は彼らを助け、彼らはまさに（フィルアウン*とその民に対する）勝利者となった。
u.src: 37:116  and We helped them, so they were victorious,

p.src: 37:117  and We gave them both the clear Scripture,

en: and We gave them both the clear Scripture,
ja: そしてわれら*は彼ら二人に解明の啓典[1]を授け、
u.src: 37:117  and We gave them both the clear Scripture,

ja: [1]　トーラー*のこと。高壁章1４５の訳注も参照。

p.src: 37:118  and guided them to the straight path;

en: and guided them to the straight path;
ja: 彼ら二人をまっすぐな道（イスラーム*）へと導いた。
u.src: 37:118  and guided them to the straight path;

p.src: 37:119  and We left for them [a favorable mention] among later generations:

en: and We left for them [a favorable mention] among later generations:
ja: また後世の人々の内に、彼ら二人へ（の賛美を）残しておいた。[1]
u.src: 37:119  and We left for them [a favorable mention] among later generations:

ja: [1]　この意味については、アーヤ*７８の訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:120  “Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.”

en: “Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.”
ja: ムーサー*とハールーン*に平安を。[1]
u.src: 37:120  “Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.”

ja: [1]　この意味については、アーヤ*７９の訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:121  This is how We reward those who do good.

en: This is how We reward those who do good.
ja: 本当にわれら*はこのように、善を尽くす者[1]たちに報いるのだ。
u.src: 37:121  This is how We reward those who do good.

ja: [1]　「善を尽くす者」については、蜜蜂章12８の訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:122  They were truly of Our believing slaves.

en: They were truly of Our believing slaves.
ja: 実に彼ら二人は、信仰者であるわれら*の僕たちの内の者である。
u.src: 37:122  They were truly of Our believing slaves.

p.src: 37:123  Elijah was indeed one of the messengers.

en: Elijah was indeed one of the messengers.
ja: また実にイルヤース*は、まさしく（預言者*として）遣わされた者の一人であった。
u.src: 37:123  Elijah was indeed one of the messengers.

p.src: 37:124  When he said to his people: “Do you not fear Allah?

en: When he said to his people: “Do you not fear Allah?
ja: 彼がその民に、（こう）言った時。「一体あなた方は、（アッラー*を）畏れ*ないのか？
u.src: 37:124  When he said to his people: “Do you not fear Allah?

p.src: 37:125  Do you call upon Ba‘l[28] and ignore the Best of the Creators,

en: Do you call upon Ba‘l[28] and ignore the Best of the Creators,
ja: 一体あなた方はバァル[1]に祈り、創造する者の内でも最善のお方（アッラー*）を放ったらかしにするというのか？
u.src: 37:125  Do you call upon Ba‘l[28] and ignore the Best of the Creators,

en: [28] A great idol worshiped by the people.
ja: [1]　「バァル」とは、彫像の名とされる（アッ＝サァディー７０７頁参照）。

p.src: 37:126  Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”

en: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”
ja: アッラー*を、つまりあなた方の主*であり、あなた方の昔の先祖の主を？」
u.src: 37:126  Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”

p.src: 37:127  But they rejected him, so they will surely be brought [for punishment],

en: But they rejected him, so they will surely be brought [for punishment],
ja: そして彼らは、彼（イルヤース*）を噓つき呼ばわりした。ゆえに、本当に彼らは（復活の日*、）必ずや（懲罰へと）連行される者となる。
u.src: 37:127  But they rejected him, so they will surely be brought [for punishment],

p.src: 37:128  except the chosen slaves of Allah.

en: except the chosen slaves of Allah.
ja: 但し、精選されたアッラー*の僕たち[1]は別であるが。
u.src: 37:128  except the chosen slaves of Allah.

ja: [1]　「精選されたアッラー*の僕」については、ユースフ*章2４の訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:129  And We left for him [a favorable mention] among later generations:

en: And We left for him [a favorable mention] among later generations:
ja: またわれら*は、後世の人々の内に、彼へ（の賛美を）残しておいた。[1]
u.src: 37:129  And We left for him [a favorable mention] among later generations:

ja: [1]　この意味については、アーヤ*７８の訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:130  “Peace be upon Elias.”

en: “Peace be upon Elias.”
ja: イル・ヤースィーン[1]に平安を。[2]
u.src: 37:130  “Peace be upon Elias.”

ja: [1]　「イル・ヤースィーン」の解釈としては、「イルヤース*自身の別称」「イルヤース*の使徒たち」など、諸説ある（アル＝バイダーウィー５：2６参照）。 [2]　この意味については、アーヤ*７９の訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:131  This is how We reward those who do good.

en: This is how We reward those who do good.
ja: 本当にわれら*はこのように、善を尽くす者[1]たちに報いるのだ。
u.src: 37:131  This is how We reward those who do good.

ja: [1]　「善を尽くす者」については、蜜蜂章12８の訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:132  He was one of Our believing slaves.

en: He was one of Our believing slaves.
ja: 実に彼（イルヤース*）は、信仰者であるわれら*の僕たちの一人である。
u.src: 37:132  He was one of Our believing slaves.

p.src: 37:133  Lot was indeed one of the messengers.

en: Lot was indeed one of the messengers.
ja: また、実にルート*は、まさに（預言者*として）遣わされた者の一人であった。[1]
u.src: 37:133  Lot was indeed one of the messengers.

ja: [1]　彼とその民の間に起こった話については、高壁章８０－８４、フード*章６９－８３、詩人たち章1６０－1７５、蟻章５４－５８、蜘蛛章2８－３５、月章３３－４０も参照。

p.src: 37:134  When We saved him and all of his household,

en: When We saved him and all of his household,
ja: われら*が彼とその家族を、皆救い出した時のこと。
u.src: 37:134  When We saved him and all of his household,

p.src: 37:135  except an old woman[29] who was among those who stayed behind.

en: except an old woman[29] who was among those who stayed behind.
ja: 但し、残っ（て滅ぼされ）た者たちの一人であった老女[1]だけは、別だったが。
u.src: 37:135  except an old woman[29] who was among those who stayed behind.

en: [29] Lot’s wife, who was not a believer.
ja: [1]　この「老女」については、詩人たち章1７1の訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:136  Then We destroyed the rest.

en: Then We destroyed the rest.
ja: それからわれら*は、（信仰者ではない）他の者たちを滅ぼした。
u.src: 37:136  Then We destroyed the rest.

p.src: 37:137  You [Makkans] pass by their ruins by day

en: You [Makkans] pass by their ruins by day
ja: そして（マッカ*の民よ）、本当にあなた方はまさしく、彼ら（ルート*の民）のもとを朝に通り過ぎている。[1]
u.src: 37:137  You [Makkans] pass by their ruins by day

ja: [1]　アル＝ヒジュル章７６とその訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:138  and by night. Do you still not understand?

en: and by night. Do you still not understand?
ja: また、夜にも。一体、あなた方は弁えないのか？
u.src: 37:138  and by night. Do you still not understand?

p.src: 37:139  Jonah was indeed one of the messengers.

en: Jonah was indeed one of the messengers.
ja: また実にユーヌス*は、まさに（預言者*として）遣わされた者の一人であった。
u.src: 37:139  Jonah was indeed one of the messengers.

p.src: 37:140  When he fled to the fully laden ship,

en: When he fled to the fully laden ship,
ja: 彼が（自分の民に立腹して、）満載の船へと逃げた時のこと。[1]
u.src: 37:140  When he fled to the fully laden ship,

ja: [1]　この出来事については、預言者*たち章８７とその訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:141  then he cast lots[30] with them, but was among those who lost.

en: then he cast lots[30] with them, but was among those who lost.
ja: そしてくじ引きをし、彼（ユーヌス*）は負けた内の者となった。[1]
u.src: 37:141  then he cast lots[30] with them, but was among those who lost.

en: [30] To determine who would be cast overboard in order to save the rest of the passengers; the ship was about to sink, for it was overloaded.
ja: [1]　船は荒波に襲われ、乗員たちは船の転覆（てんぷく）を恐れた。それで彼らは船の重量を減らすため、誰が犠牲になるかで、くじ引きをした（ムヤッサル４５1頁参照）。

p.src: 37:142  The whale then swallowed him while he was blameworthy[31].

en: The whale then swallowed him while he was blameworthy[31].
ja: こうして（ユーヌス*は海に落とされたが）、大魚が彼を呑み込んだ。彼は咎められるべき者であった。
u.src: 37:142  The whale then swallowed him while he was blameworthy[31].

en: [31] For leaving his people without Allah’s permission.

p.src: 37:143  Were it not for the fact that he was one of those who glorify Allah,

en: Were it not for the fact that he was one of those who glorify Allah,
ja: もし彼が、（アッラー*を）よく称える*者の一人でなかったなら、[1]
u.src: 37:143  Were it not for the fact that he was one of those who glorify Allah,

ja: [1]　それ以前に行っていた多くの崇拝*行為や正しい行い*がなかったら、という意味とされる。預言者*たち章８７に描写されている、この時の彼の言葉も参照（前掲書、同頁参照）。

p.src: 37:144  he would have stayed in its belly until the Day of Resurrection[32].

en: he would have stayed in its belly until the Day of Resurrection[32].
ja: 彼らが蘇らされる（復活*の）日まで、その腹の中に留まったことであろう。[1]
u.src: 37:144  he would have stayed in its belly until the Day of Resurrection[32].

en: [32] The belly of the fish would have turned to be his grave.
ja: [1]　そこが彼の墓となったであろう、という意味（前掲書、同頁参照）。

p.src: 37:145  But We cast him ashore on a barren land while he was ill,

en: But We cast him ashore on a barren land while he was ill,
ja: こうしてわれら*は彼を（大魚の腹の内から）、弱り切った状態で、不毛の地に放り投げた。
u.src: 37:145  But We cast him ashore on a barren land while he was ill,

p.src: 37:146  and caused a gourd vine[33] to grow over him.

en: and caused a gourd vine[33] to grow over him.
ja: そしてわれら*は彼の上に、瓜の木[1]を一本、生やしてやった。
u.src: 37:146  and caused a gourd vine[33] to grow over him.

en: [33] For its cooling shade and as food for him.
ja: [1]　これにより彼は日陰と、その他の益を得た（前掲書、同頁参照）。

p.src: 37:147  We sent him[34] to one hundred thousand people or more,

en: We sent him[34] to one hundred thousand people or more,
ja: またわれら*は彼を十万人、いや、それ以上（の民）へと遣わした。[1]
u.src: 37:147  We sent him[34] to one hundred thousand people or more,

en: [34] i.e., We sent him thereafter to his people.
ja: [1]　そもそもユーヌス*が預言者*として遣わされたのは、大魚から出た後のことであるという説もある。また大魚から出た後、彼が自分の民だけでなく、別の民にも遣わされたのだ、という説もある（イブン・カスィール７：４０参照）。

p.src: 37:148  and they believed, so We let them enjoy for a while.

en: and they believed, so We let them enjoy for a while.
ja: そして彼らは信じ、われら*は彼らを（彼らに死が訪れる）その時まで楽しませておいた。
u.src: 37:148  and they believed, so We let them enjoy for a while.

p.src: 37:149  So ask them, “Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?”[35]

en: So ask them, “Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?”[35]
ja: ならば、（使徒*よ）、彼ら（マッカ*の不信仰者*たち）に尋ねよ。一体あなたの主*には娘があり、彼らには息子があるのか、と。[1]
u.src: 37:149  So ask them, “Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?”[35]

en: [35] The pagans of Makkah claimed that angels were Allah’s daughters, while preferring sons for themselves.
ja: [1]　このアーヤ*の意味については、蜜蜂章５７とその訳注を参照。

p.src: 37:150  Or did We create the angels as females while they were watching?

en: Or did We create the angels as females while they were watching?
ja: それとも、われら*は彼らが立ち会う中、天使*を女として創ったのか？
u.src: 37:150  Or did We create the angels as females while they were watching?

p.src: 37:151  No indeed, it is one of their fabrications when they say,

en: No indeed, it is one of their fabrications when they say,
ja: 本当に彼らはでっち上げて、まさに（こう）言っているのではないか。
u.src: 37:151  No indeed, it is one of their fabrications when they say,

p.src: 37:152  “Allah has children,” and they are truly liars.

en: “Allah has children,” and they are truly liars.
ja: 「アッラー*は子供をお産みになった」。本当に彼らは、まさしく噓つきなのだ。
u.src: 37:152  “Allah has children,” and they are truly liars.

p.src: 37:153  Did He choose daughters over sons[36]?

en: Did He choose daughters over sons[36]?
ja: 一体かれが、息子を差しおいて娘をお選びになったというのか？
u.src: 37:153  Did He choose daughters over sons[36]?

en: [36] i.e., daughters that you hate over sons that you like?

p.src: 37:154  What is the matter with you? How do you judge?

en: What is the matter with you? How do you judge?
ja: 一体、あなた方はどうしたことか？あなた方はいかに（不当な）決め方をするのか？
u.src: 37:154  What is the matter with you? How do you judge?

p.src: 37:155  Will you not then take heed?

en: Will you not then take heed?
ja: 一体、あなた方は教訓を受けないのか？
u.src: 37:155  Will you not then take heed?

p.src: 37:156  Do you have any compelling proof?

en: Do you have any compelling proof?
ja: いや、一体あなた方には（そのような主張への、）紛れもない証拠でもあるというのか？
u.src: 37:156  Do you have any compelling proof?

p.src: 37:157  Then bring your scripture, if you are truthful.

en: Then bring your scripture, if you are truthful.
ja: では、あなた方の啓典を持って来てみよ。もし、あなた方が本当のことを言っているのなら。
u.src: 37:157  Then bring your scripture, if you are truthful.

p.src: 37:158  They claim that there is a kinship between Him and the jinn[37], when the jinn themselves know that such people will surely be brought [for punishment].

en: They claim that there is a kinship between Him and the jinn[37], when the jinn themselves know that such people will surely be brought [for punishment].
ja: 彼ら（シルク*の徒）は、かれ（アッラー*）とジン*の間に近親関係をもうけた。そしてジン*は確かに、彼ら（シルク*の徒）が（復活の日*、懲罰へと）まさしく連行されることを、知っているのだ。[1]
u.src: 37:158  They claim that there is a kinship between Him and the jinn[37], when the jinn themselves know that such people will surely be brought [for punishment].

en: [37] It was claimed by some Arab pagans that angels are daughters of Allah through female jinn.
ja: [1]　ここでの「ジン*」は、大半の学者によれば天使*のこと（アル＝クルトゥビー1５：1３５参照）。

p.src: 37:159  Glorified is Allah far above what they ascribe [to Him].

en: Glorified is Allah far above what they ascribe [to Him].
ja: 彼らの言うようなことから（無縁な）、アッラー*に称え*あれ。[1]
u.src: 37:159  Glorified is Allah far above what they ascribe [to Him].

ja: [1]　雌牛章11６の訳注も参照。

p.src: 37:160  But not the chosen slaves of Allah[38].

en: But not the chosen slaves of Allah[38].
ja: 但し、精選されたアッラー*の僕たち[1]は別であるが。[2]
u.src: 37:160  But not the chosen slaves of Allah[38].

en: [38] Who do not ascribe to Allah such false claims.
ja: [1]　「精選されたアッラー*の僕」については、ユースフ*章2４の訳注を参照。 [2]　つまり、彼らはアッラー*にふさわしくないことを言わない（ムヤッサル４５2頁参照）。

p.src: 37:161  So you and whatever you worship

en: So you and whatever you worship
ja: （シルク*の徒よ、）本当にあなた方と、あなた方が（アッラー*を差しおいて）崇めているもの、
u.src: 37:161  So you and whatever you worship

p.src: 37:162  none of you can lure anyone away from Him,

en: none of you can lure anyone away from Him,
ja: あなた方はそれゆえに、（誰かを）迷わせる（ことが出来る）者ではない、
u.src: 37:162  none of you can lure anyone away from Him,

p.src: 37:163  except those who are destined to burn in the Blazing Fire[39].

en: except those who are destined to burn in the Blazing Fire[39].
ja: （不信仰ゆえに）火獄に入り炙られる（ことになる、とアッラー*によって定められた）者を除いては。
u.src: 37:163  except those who are destined to burn in the Blazing Fire[39].

en: [39] Due to their disbelief and evil deeds.

p.src: 37:164  [The angels say][40], “There is none among us but has a known station[41]:

en: [The angels say][40], “There is none among us but has a known station[41]:
ja: （天使*たちは、言う。）「私たちの内で、（天に）特定の持ち場[1]がない者はいない。
u.src: 37:164  [The angels say][40], “There is none among us but has a known station[41]:

en:
